source: Written for this app. NOT AI Video Bootcamp course material. Found by reading the code: with Compose's Lighting on (auto), build_prompt.select_layers() drew one of prompt_bank.json's nine lighting terms at random by seed with no reference to the Setting, so 'a cocktail bar at night' could be lit by 'golden hour sunlight'. A subject lit one way inside a scene that implies another is the classic pasted-in look.
note: Three parts. `places` and `times` NARROW the lighting layer's own pick: each lists `allowed`, a subset of prompt_bank.json's lighting.terms, and build_prompt.select_layers() runs the same weighted pick() over that subset - so history.weights() and every rating keep working, and nothing here ever writes a lighting term the bank does not own (tests/test_scene_light.py asserts it). `source` names the actual light in that place. `surfaces` and `shadows` are the two physical consequences generators leave out: colour picked up from nearby surfaces, and one shadow direction for subject and scene with a contact shadow where they meet. The phrase rides spec['overrides']['scene_light'], a non-layer override appended to the free tail, so it can only add to a realism score. No phrase is written as a refusal - realism_lint.is_negated() would discount the keyword next to it. A place may give a `by_time` source that replaces its default when a time is also named - a street at night is lit by street lamps, not by open sky.

night.source: the warm practical lights of the place and the cooler glow spilling in from outside

golden.source: a low, warm sun raking in from the side

overcast.source: a bright, even sky diffused by cloud

bar.source: the warm pendant lamps over the bar and the glow of the back shelf

candlelit.source: a low, warm, flickering flame close to the subject

street.source: open sky above the street, bouncing off the buildings

by_time.night: street lamps overhead and the glow of shop windows, pooling light on the pavement
by_time.golden: a low sun raking down the street between the buildings

studio.source: a large softbox key just off camera

window-interior.source: daylight from the nearest window, falling off across the room

by_time.night: warm table and floor lamps inside, the windows dark
by_time.golden: low, warm sun slanting in through the window

office.source: overhead office lighting mixed with daylight from the windows

by_time.night: overhead office lighting and the glow of desk lamps, the windows dark

forest.source: sun filtered through the leaves, dappling the ground

by_time.golden: low sun breaking through the trunks in long shafts
by_time.overcast: soft, even skylight under the canopy

beach.source: the open sky and the sun off the water

by_time.golden: a low sun over the water, warm and raking
by_time.night: the glow of the boardwalk lights and a pale moon over the water

snow.source: bright, cool light from the sky bouncing up off the snow

desert.source: a strong sun with nothing to soften it

wood.phrase: warm bounce light off the wooden surfaces lifting the shadows with a faint amber tint

grass.phrase: a faint green tint in the shadows from light bouncing off the grass

brick.phrase: a warm reddish spill from the brick walls on the near side of the face

snow.phrase: cool light bouncing up off the snow, filling under the chin and brows

sand.phrase: warm light reflected up off the sand, softening the shadows under the chin

water.phrase: faint moving reflections from the water playing across the skin

concrete.phrase: a neutral grey bounce off the hard ground, flat and cool in the shadows

neon.phrase: a coloured spill from the neon sign along one side of the face and hair

fire.phrase: a warm orange flicker on the skin, strongest on the side nearest the flame

foliage.phrase: a soft green cast in the shade under the trees

screen.phrase: a cool blue glow from the screen on the face

coherence: the subject's shadow falling in the same direction as every other shadow in the scene
one consistent light direction across the subject and the background, shadows agreeing
shadows on the subject and the surroundings cast by the same source, at the same angle
contact: a soft contact shadow where the subject meets the surface beneath them
a dark, soft-edged contact shadow where hands and feet touch the surfaces they rest on
a grounded contact shadow under the subject, darkest right where they touch
